[[File:Mitchell HZ019.png|thumb|250px|Mitchell]] '''Mitchell''' (Japanese: '''ミッチェル''' ''Mitchell'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|HZ}}. He is a {{wp|pâtisserie}} and an old colleague of [[Murdock]]. ==History== Mitchell debuted in ''[[HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth]]''. While shopping in [[Galar]], [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and Murdock paid a visit to Mitchell's [[Battle Café]] in [[Motostoke]], hoping to obtain a {{p|Slurpuff}}-shaped cotton candy. Due to their shared animosity, Mitchell and Murdock were hostile towards each other. Murdock explained that some time ago, he and Mitchell were rivals working in a pastry shop. Together, they sold cakes made with cream from Murdock's {{p|Milcery}}. One day, Milcery evolved into a {{form|Alcremie|Strawberry Ruby Swirl}} {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}}, which made its cream work better with Murdock's ruby cakes over Mitchell's matcha cakes. Jealous of Murdock's newfound success, Mitchell grew resentful towards his friend until one day, he lashed out at him. Murdock, furious at Mitchell's behavior, chose to leave the shop. Hoping to get the two to reconcile, Liko suggested that she and Murdock face Mitchell in a battle together. The plan was a success, as the battle quickly became a sweets battle where Mitchell and Murdock competed in making cakes. With help from Liko, the pair combined their different styles to create a new way of decorating cakes. After Mitchell apologized for his past actions, he and Murdock agreed to become friends again. In the [[HZ020|next episode]], Mitchell and Murdock watched as Liko and Roy went off with [[Kabu]]. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mitchell |pkmn=Vanillite |type1=Ice |img=Mitchell Vanillite.png |epnum=HZ019 |epname=The Bittersweet Truth |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Vanillite}} is Mitchell's first known Pokémon. It was seen battling a Trainer's {{p|Cufant}}, but was defeated by an {{m|Iron Head}}. None of Vanillite's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mitchell |pkmn=Slurpuff |type1=Fairy |img=Mitchell Slurpuff.png |epnum=HZ019 |epname=The Bittersweet Truth |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Slurpuff}} is Mitchell's second known Pokémon. It was first shown holding a {{p|Swirlix}}-shaped cotton candy for a Trainer who defeated Mitchell. Later, it was used alongside {{p|Appletun}} in the [[Double Battle]] against [[Murdock]] and [[Liko]]. Slurpuff's only known move is {{m|Cotton Spore}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mitchell |pkmn=Appletun |type1=Grass |type2=Dragon |img=Mitchell Appletun.png |epnum=HZ019 |epname=The Bittersweet Truth |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Appletun}} is Mitchell's third known Pokémon. Appletun was used alongside {{p|Slurpuff}} in the [[Double Battle]] against [[Murdock]] and [[Liko]]. Appletun's only known move is {{m|Apple Acid}}.}} ===Partnered with=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mitchell |pkmn=Milcery |main=Murdock's Alcremie |type1=Fairy |img=Murdock Milcery.png |gender=female |epnum=HZ019 |epname=The Bittersweet Truth |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Milcery}} often worked with Mitchell and Murdock to create their sweets.
